description: (c) DEBUGEVT is categorized outside the HardFault family instead of sharing HFSR's category

edits.replace:
faults.extend(_extract(hfsr, _HFSR_BITS, "HardFault"))
    faults[:] = [
        ActiveBit(category="Debug", name=f.name, meaning=f.meaning)
        if f.name == "DEBUGEVT" else f
        for f in faults
    ]

    debug = _extract(dfsr, _DFSR_BITS, "Debug")
